title: Quickstart editorial preflights exact wire inputs and splits only oversized batches
steps: Run the three declared Node test suites.
expect: Oversized batches split deterministically while every requested field and immutable source remains included.
All batches preflight before any provider dispatch; an unshrinkable single-field request makes zero paid calls.
Admitted batch inputs retain their prior hashes and repair requests preflight without resetting attempt history.
fence: Uses the same qualityExecutionInput and qualityCallBudget as paid dispatch; no increased token or monetary limits.
